selection_reasoning: These tasks form a natural spatial dependency chain. The potted pink tulip will be placed inside or on top of a brick structure. The player must first locate and navigate to the brick structure (find bricks), and only then can they discover and mine the potted pink tulip that is situated within that brick building. This creates a meaningful exploration-then-action sequence: find the landmark, then interact with the object at that landmark. Both tasks are easily observable and verifiable, and require no deep Minecraft crafting knowledge — just navigation and block-breaking.

edges.reason: The potted pink tulip is located inside a brick structure; player must first find the brick building to locate and mine the tulip within it

milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The player must navigate near the brick building (centered at spawn-relative [12, 2, 11]) and face it to demonstrate they have found it. max_distance=5 ensures the player is close enough to clearly see the bricks, and facing_tolerance=60 ensures they are looking at the structure. This is preferred over position_inside_box because 'find' tasks should verify the player can see the target, not just be near it.

Uses inventory_has because mining a potted_pink_tulip drops a flower_pot and a pink_tulip into the player's inventory. Checking for pink_tulip (min_count=1) confirms the player successfully mined the potted plant. This is preferred over position-based checks because the task is about mining (obtaining the drop), not navigation. The potted tulip is not in the starting inventory so any pink_tulip in inventory proves the block was mined.

scene_description: A flat grass clearing with a dirt path leading from spawn to a small brick building (~12 blocks away). The building has a 2-wide doorway on the front (north-facing) wall and contains a potted pink tulip on the floor inside. A glass pane window decorates the front wall next to the door.
task_text: Find the brick building, then go inside and mine the potted pink tulip.
design_notes: Building spans ~10-14 on X, ~0-5 on Y, ~8-14 on Z (all spawn-relative). Doorway is 2 blocks wide at ~11-12, ~1-3, ~8. Potted tulip at ~12, ~1, ~12 (center-back of interior). Path guides player from spawn toward building front. Area cleared of trees to ensure navigation.
